# Airbnb

> > Airbnb is a global marketplace for vacation rentals, unique stays, local experiences, and professional services, expanding beyond accommodations to offer a comprehensive travel and lifestyle platform.

Airbnb connects hosts with guests for short-term lodging and experiences worldwide. The platform recently expanded with the 2025 Summer Release to include Airbnb Services, a marketplace for local professional services, alongside its traditional vacation rentals and Experiences offerings. Led by CEO Brian Chesky, the company emphasizes community, belonging, and innovative travel solutions.
